"""Tests for Scripts/systems.py markdown generation."""

from systems import build_markdown_tables


SAMPLE = [
    {
        'PVSystemName': 'Game Boy',
        'PVManufacturer': 'Nintendo',
        'PVReleaseYear': 1989,
        'PVBit': 8,
        'PVPortable': True,
        'PVSupportsRumble': False,
        'PVUsesCDs': False,
        'PVRequiresBIOS': False,
    },
    {
        'PVSystemName': 'PlayStation',
        'PVManufacturer': 'Sony',
        'PVReleaseYear': 1994,
        'PVBit': 32,
        'PVPortable': False,
        'PVSupportsRumble': True,
        'PVUsesCDs': True,
        'PVRequiresBIOS': True,
        'PVBIOSNames': [
            {
                'Name': 'scph5501.bin',
                'MD5': '490F666E1AFB15B7362B406ED1CEA246',
                'Description': 'NTSC-U/C BIOS',
                'Optional': False,
            }
        ],
    },
]


def test_returns_string():
    result = build_markdown_tables(SAMPLE)
    assert isinstance(result, str)


def test_contains_headers_and_systems():
    md = build_markdown_tables(SAMPLE)
    assert '# Emulator Systems Overview' in md
    assert '## System Features' in md
    assert '## BIOS Requirements' in md
    assert 'Game Boy' in md
    assert 'PlayStation' in md


def test_sorted_by_manufacturer():
    # Nintendo sorts before Sony, so Game Boy's row appears before PlayStation's.
    md = build_markdown_tables(SAMPLE)
    assert md.index('Game Boy') < md.index('PlayStation')


def test_bios_required_gets_anchor_link():
    md = build_markdown_tables(SAMPLE)
    # PlayStation requires a BIOS, so its feature-table cell links to the anchor.
    assert '[✓](#bios-playstation)' in md
    assert '<a name="bios-playstation">' in md
    # Game Boy does not require a BIOS -> plain cross mark, no link.
    assert '#bios-game-boy' not in md


def test_bios_entry_rendered_with_md5_search_link():
    md = build_markdown_tables(SAMPLE)
    assert 'scph5501.bin' in md
    assert 'https://www.google.com/search?q=490F666E1AFB15B7362B406ED1CEA246' in md
